channel.title: The Daily Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Daily Signal (dailysignal.com)

item.title: Trump Tells Senators to Pass the SAVE America Act ‘for Jesus’
item.description: Trump urges Senate to add DHS funding to the SAVE America Act and remain in Washington until the election security bill passes.

item.title: Gas Taxes Are Rising Nationally—and Nowhere More Than California
item.description: As gas taxes rise nationwide, California leads with the steepest costs. Experts say EVs and environmental rules are driving prices higher.

item.title: Even Amid Lawsuit, Democrat AG Won't Swear Off Using Far-Left 'Hate Map' That Allegedly Inspired Terrorist Attack
item.description: Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel won't swear off using the SPLC's "hate map" despite conservative group's lawsuit.

item.title: 2 Democrats Side With Republicans to Confirm Mullin for DHS Secretary
item.description: The Senate confirms Sen. Markwayne Mullin, R-Okla., to be the new secretary of the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Why the Long TSA Lines? New Mobile Billboards at These Airports Aim to Explain
item.description: Mobile billboards are being deployed at the three Washington, D.C.-area airports amid the DHS shutdown that has led to long TSA lines.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Texas Lawmakers Demand GOP Fight for Stronger Child Protections Against AI
item.description: A bipartisan group of 20 Texas state senators write the state's U.S. senators demanding stronger protections for children online.

item.title: A Tariff Ceasefire in Time of War Would Help Everybody
item.description: The president can deprive Tehran of its goal to push our economy into reverse by cutting a deal on planned global tariff increases.

item.title: Paul Ehrlich’s Failed Doomsday Predictions Expose the Media’s Climate Alarmism Double Standard
item.description: Ehrlich predicted mass starvation would kill hundreds of millions in the 1970s and 1980s. That didn't happen.

item.title: Oklahoma Governor Reveals Markwayne Mullin Senate Replacement
item.description: Oklahoma Gov. Kevin Stitt has announced that an energy executive will fill the vacant Senate seat left by Markwayne Mullin.

item.title: Delta Suspends Special Services for Congress Amid Shutdown
item.description: Amid a five-week DHS shutdown, Delta Airlines is suspending a special service desk for members of Congress.
